recentItems.title: Tourism Month | Nelson Mandela Bay looks to push tourism to boost local economy
recentItems.description:

But with growing competition from other destinations, the question is whether the metro is doing enough to attract visitors and turn tourism into jobs and opportunities for local communities.

recentItems.title: Carletonville tavern shooting | Family members start identifying loved ones killed in the attack
recentItems.description:
Gauteng police are hunting eight armed suspects after a mass shooting at a tavern in Wedela on the West Rand left 17 people dead and 15 others wounded. 

Police say the suspects, armed with AK-47 rifles and pistols, opened fire on patrons inside and outside the tavern on Saturday night. 

The suspects allegedly stole cellphones from some patrons before fleeing in two vehicles, which were later set alight.

For more on this, we are now joined by SABC News Reporter Calvin Dludla

recentItems.title: LGE 2026 | Communities put municipalities under sportlight
recentItems.description:
As South Africa heads towards the Local Government Elections, questions around service delivery and the performance of municipalities are once again taking centre stage.

Communities expect local government to deliver reliable basic services, responsive leadership and meaningful opportunities to improve their livelihoods. But what should voters expect from their local leaders and what should communities demand from those seeking their support? 

To discuss this further, we are joined on Zoom by Bohlale Buzani, Community Activist from Mdantsane in the Eastern Cape under Buffalo City Municipality, Thapelo Mohapi from Abahlali baseMjondolo and Advice Chuma, from the Alexandra Township.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Ekurhuleni Murders | Thembisa residents grateful an arrest was made following woman's murder
recentItems.description:
A suspect has been arrested in connection with the murder of a woman in Thembisa, Ekurhuleni.

The woman's body was discovered on Saturday near Mooifontein Cemetery. 

Police spokesperson Athlenda Mathe says the suspect fled to Limpopo following the murder.

SABC News reporter Neria Hlakotsa is in Thembisa...

recentItems.title: Ten people were shot and killed and eleven others injured at an entertainment place #sabcnews #fyp
recentItems.description:
Police in the Western Cape have increased their deployment in Lwandle, Strand, after ten people were shot and killed and eleven others injured at an entertainment place in the early hours of on Sunday morning. Five people died at the scene, while five others later succumbed to their injuries after being taken to medical facilities. Eleven others are receiving medical treatment.

recentItems.title: At least 17 people have been shot and killed in a tavern in Carletonville  #sabcnews #following
recentItems.description:
At least 17 people have been shot and killed in a tavern in Carletonville on the Gauteng West Rand. More than 20 people were also injured in the deadly shooting in a crowded tavern. Police say men armed with AK-47 rifles and pistols stormed the venue and opened fire. They allegedly searched some patrons and took their cellphones before fleeing. Two vehicles were also set alight during the attack.
